before_ingredients_html:
Simplified version

Use good plain ready-salted crisps (80 g for two) in place of fried potatoes and omit the tomato sauce. Cook the beef, add garlic yoghurt and assemble just before eating. This shortcut changes the potato texture but keeps the main contrasts.

intro_html: A Bodrum-style layered plate, adapted to thin-film pan-frying in a small galley. Planned for Göcek, Turkey · 24 October–around 7 November 2026. Also works in a home kitchen. See the seasonal shopping and supplier guide.

notes.html:
• Make the core ingredient list first.
  • Optional additions are separate; each is called out where it enters.
  • Quantities serve two.
  • Cook meat and seafood just before eating; keep dairy and raw ingredients refrigerated at 0–4 °C.
  • Prep vegetables before raw meat or use a separate board and clean tools.

steps.body_html:
• Peel potatoes and cut into 3 mm matchsticks.
  • Rinse in cold drinking water, drain and dry thoroughly in a towel.
  • Wet potatoes spit and will not crisp.
  • Mix yoghurt with garlic and a pinch of the measured salt; keep chilled.
steps.title: Cut and dry the potatoes

steps.body_html:
• Divide 3 tbsp oil between two or three potato batches in a 26 cm pan over medium-high heat.
  • Fry in loose single layers, turning gently, for about 6–9 minutes per batch until golden and tender; thin-film frying gives crisp edges rather than deep-fried shoestrings.
  • Drain in one layer, salt lightly and leave uncovered.
  • Lower heat if darkening before tender.
  • Cook at a calm berth; avoid hot-oil frying while the boat is moving.
steps.title: Pan-fry in small batches

steps.body_html:
• If using the sauce, pour off the potato oil into a heatproof container.
  • Melt butter in the pan over low heat; stir tomato paste for 30 seconds, add water and optional pepper, and simmer 1 minute.
  • Pour into a cup.
  • Omit this step if skipping the sauce.
steps.title: Make the optional sauce

steps.body_html:
• Slice beef across the grain into 5 mm strips on a clean meat board.
  • Pat dry and season with remaining salt.
  • Heat the last tbsp oil over high heat; fry in two uncrowded batches for 2–3 minutes each, turning once.
  • Check 63 °C and rest 3 minutes on a clean plate.
steps.title: Sear the beef

steps.body_html:
• Divide potatoes between plates, spoon yoghurt across the middle and pile beef on top.
  • Add optional tomato sauce in a narrow line.
  • Serve immediately; mixing everything or waiting under a lid makes the potatoes soggy.
steps.title: Layer just before eating

title: Çökertme (beef, crisp potatoes & garlic yoghurt)
